The symbolic/rational and independent geometric checker passed 10,218 assertions, and its finite tests are explicitly not treated as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The result determines the entire exact area-diameter feasible region, a natural two-invariant question prompted by current random-section geometry. A diameter can remain fixed while area varies nontrivially, with a uniquely asymmetrical minimizing normal distinct from the two-equal-coordinate maximizing normal. This structural classification and all sharp equality cases are not a renaming or calculation of the already-known marginal diameter law; no downstream theorem is required for the natural invariant to be valuable.
